messages:
leo (partnerships): flagging an oddity from last night's marketplace exports: partner report shows a steady hourly slice but our aggregator shows spikes exactly on DST boundary in EU zone. can someone sanity-check windowing? :thinking_face:

harpreet (cloud-partner): we export usage in UTC hourly buckets per marketplace contract. sample export line: 2024-10-27T01:00:00Z,contract=azure-enterprise-44,sku=redwood.chat.medium,units=120

maria (eng-sre): our ingestion groups by partner_bucket_ts and then attributes to customer invoice hour in local tz. looks like we used Europe/Paris for some tenants and Europe/London for others; DST change Oct 27 caused a duplicated hour for CET->CEST shift.

dana (billing): consequence: customers in CET saw a duplicated hour counted twice, increasing billable units for that hour. estimated exposure for Oct 27 is ~2.3k units across 12 tenants.

leo (partnerships): do we have a rule for attributing UTC hourly exports to regional billing windows? I thought marketplace export already aligned to UTC and we should keep it that way.

maria (eng-sre): historically we attempted local-window attribution for timezone-aware customers, but marketplace contracts expect UTC-aligned billing. looks like the connector defaulted to local attribution when tenant.timezone set. that's the bug.

harpreet (cloud-partner): confirming on our side: exports are UTC buckets. we include tenant_tz for display only. spec says "do not rebucket". link: https://marketplace.partner/docs/usage-export#hourly-buckets

partners-bot: created ticket PART-5622 (hourly-windowing-dst-dup) assigned to maria.

leo (partnerships): remediation plan? we need corrected usage events for accounting and a stopgap validation so future exporters can't be rebucketed locally.

maria (eng-sre): plan: 1) patch connector to trust export_ts as authoritative UTC bucket (no rebucketing), 2) backfill recompute for Oct 27 for affected tenants and push corrected usage deltas to reconciliation queue, 3) add a QA check that flags tenant.timezone != "UTC" when export_source=="marketplace" and halts staging deploys until acknowledged.

dana (billing): please include per-tenant CSV with original vs corrected units and a recommended credit amount. finance will need partner sign-off for credits > $1k.

harpreet (cloud-partner): we'll accept corrected usage and provide a signed confirmation once we validate. also can add explicit field export_timezone=UTC in future exports to prevent ambiguity.

leo (partnerships): timeline?

maria (eng-sre): hotfix in 3 hours, dry-run backfill to staging in 8 hours, production backfill and reconciliation queue emit in 18 hours. I'll update PART-5622 with logs.

dana (billing): cc-ing finance manager for approval threshold.

harpreet (cloud-partner): thanks everyone. we'll pause any downstream invoice generation until we get the corrected CSV. :white_check_mark:
